description_en: Queries all log delivery configurations of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance for hybrid cloud
description_zh: 查询所有混合云日志外发投递配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-log-delivery-configs --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLogDeliveryConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的外发投递配置名称。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询某个外发投递配置
parameters.name: delivery_name_like

parameters.help_en:
The type of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Valid values:

syslog: Log delivery to a syslog server.

kafka: Log delivery to a Kafka cluster
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的外发投递配置类型。取值为：

syslog：表示外发到syslog服务。
kafka：表示外发到kafka服务
parameters.name: delivery_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值。首页查询无需传入
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-50，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

items.description_en: The details of a log delivery configuration

DeliveryDetail.description_en:
The details of the log delivery configuration, returned as a JSON string.

The structure of this parameter is the same as the DeliveryDetail request parameter of the [CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~) operation
DeliveryDetail.description_zh:
外发投递配置内容，以一系列参数构造的 JSON 格式转化成字符串。

与CreateLogDeliveryConfig接口的DeliveryDetail参数相同。相关描述，请参见[CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~)接口的外发投递配置内容参数描述

DeliveryName.description_en: The name of the log delivery configuration

DeliveryType.description_en:
The type of the log delivery configuration. Valid values:

syslog: Log delivery to a syslog server.

kafka: Log delivery to a Kafka cluster
DeliveryType.description_zh:
外发投递配置类型。取值为：

syslog：表示外发到syslog服务。
kafka：表示外发到kafka服务

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-50，默认值为20

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If this parameter is not empty, more results are available. Use the value of NextToken in the next request to retrieve the next page of results. If the value is empty, all results have been returned
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页查询凭证（Token），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。

该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of log delivery configurations returned
